summary: Guides carry a build manifest, and publishing saves it in InteropHub for the guide status page.
Appendices and chapter-count warnings, an ideas register, a Collecting ideas status, and a topic-based restricted-use notice for private projects.
A private Standing Topic Reference can be kept in a shared folder without Git and published only to InteropHub.
Review flags are drawn in purple with a badge and bar, and set from a flag button.
Comment forms keep unsaved drafts, explain blocked requests, and show character counts.
Row anchors make each row of a marked table its own review area.
Publishing workflows install pandoc from its GitHub release.
Guides declare their hosting, and private guides can be uploaded to InteropHub.
Workspace Topic References, kept in a shared folder without Git.
Every Topic Reference has a primary infographic; guides embed images and draw Mermaid diagrams.
The guide no longer stalls scrolling at section boundaries.
Topic References can be public or private.
New Topic References drop the maintenance section and process decisions.
Conventions to state each fact once and keep chapters few, with a chapter-count warning.
Product staleness checks, and a fix for lost Word section headings that needs a _quarto.yml change.
Expressive slide patterns for rapid presentations.
Author review of comments: dispositions, closing, and review flags.
Signed-in comments through a comments service.
Reading copies remove anchors without extra blank lines.
Stable review anchors for guide comments.
Topic Reference guidance and skeleton.
Rapid PowerPoint template and generator.
Fix for the hidden comment box in the web guide.
Self-contained web guide with on-page comments.
First public release.
